newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow in the panhandle area on Tuesday, USDA said.

Slaughter steers not well tested and heifers steady in light test. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 300 slaughter steers and 700 heifers; 2,400 head confirmed for week to date.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 68.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 975-1050 lbs 68.00.
Wk to Date - 2,400 Week Ago - 76,100 Year Ago - 20,100
